name: Shade
description: Ethereal undead scout that can phase through obstacles. Very fragile but extremely hard to catch.

specialAbilities.name: Phase Walk
specialAbilities.description: Can move through units and terrain obstacles

specialAbilities.name: Death Vision

specialAbilities.description: Becomes invisible for a short duration

bonuses.description: Regenerates 0.5 health per second on blight
